name: OpenJSCAD
tagline: Write JavaScript, get a 3D solid — the script lives in the file.
description:
The script and the model live in this file, so it works on a plane, and a friend who opens your invite gets the same design.

Type a JSCAD script (or tap Cube / Gear), press Run, orbit the solid. Parameters in the script become sliders. STL downloads the mesh. Close it and come back — the last script is still here.

On a phone, Model and Script are two taps. One finger orbits, a pinch zooms, Run sits on both screens.

An unofficial port of OpenJSCAD by the JSCAD Organization. Same language: require('@jscad/modeling'), main() returns a shape.
